scripts.test: npm run toolchain:check && sh scripts/cargo.sh test --workspace --locked && node --test web/test/*.test.mjs && npm run smoke
scripts.lint: npm run toolchain:check && sh scripts/cargo.sh fmt --all -- --check && sh scripts/cargo.sh clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && node scripts/lint-web.mjs
scripts.build: npm run toolchain:check && sh scripts/cargo.sh build --workspace --locked && node scripts/build-web.mjs
scripts.bench: npm run toolchain:check && sh scripts/cargo.sh bench --workspace --no-run --locked
